text:
maria-ops: FYI vendor just confirmed partial DOA on last rack shipment — need to coordinate RMAs + split replacement for EU clusters. PO#5483.

jordan-purchasing: can you paste RMA number / photos? also we need estimated cost to expedite.

lee-logistics: RMA created: RMA-2026-00472. Vendor uploaded pics and AWB. Shipping currently held at LAX due to customs docs mismatch. Link: https://trk.nexasupply.example/awb/ZX12345

nexa-supply-vendor: Apologies — 12 units flagged as DOA after QC. We issued RMA-2026-00472 and are ready to send replacements. Standard lead time for new units is 6–8 weeks; we can offer 8 refurbished-tested units immediate at 15% discount.

alex-engr: We need at least 8 GPUs deployed in eus1 by month end for a canary rollout. 6–8 weeks is not acceptable. Any chance of cross-shipping from US spare pool?

sam-sre: Confirming impact: two dedicated clusters are at 70% capacity and will hit limits if we don't replenish. We need temporary lift or partial replacements ASAP.

maria-ops: @nexa-supply-vendor can you split the shipment? send 4 replacements to EU (DHL express) and the rest to us in US? We can absorb tariffs if vendor covers expedited freight credit.

nexa-supply-vendor: We can split but customs/tech docs differ per region. For EU express split: +$1,100 per shipment for DHL express + export paperwork. If Redwood covers customs clearance fees we can prioritize.

jordan-purchasing: Approvals: we can ok up to $3k for express freight on this PO. Need final invoice line items and AWB before approving spend.

lee-logistics: Customs flagged that current paperwork lists "replacement goods" with $0 value — EU customs needs commercial invoice stating nominal value and warranty replacement note or they hold shipment. I can patch docs but vendor must sign corrected invoice.

nexa-supply-vendor: We'll issue a commercial invoice: value $1/unit, marked 'warranty replacement - no commercial value'. Re-issuing now.

rma-bot: RMA-2026-00472 status updated -> awaiting vendor invoice (2026-11-09T14:12:03Z)

maria-ops: Also need serial numbers for each replacement to map to nodes (we track by hw-id). Vendor — please include serials in ASN.

nexa-supply-vendor: We'll include serials in ASN but note: some refurbished units will have different HW revisions. We'll list exact SKUs and serials in the ASN.

alex-engr: Ok. If refurbished have older microcode, we need to schedule quick compatibility patch. Can you label which serials are 'refurb'?

nexa-supply-vendor: Yes, prefix refurb serials with RF- in ASN.

jordan-purchasing: Pricing reconciliation: replacement shipping (expedited EU split) $1,100, customs handling $250, refurb unit credit $1,200 per unit. If we accept 4 refurb + 4 new split, net cost delta ~ $2,400. Need final total to push PO amendment.

maria-ops: Proposal: Accept 4 refurbished (to get them out in 2–3 business days) for eus1, and request 4 new from next production batch to US pool. Vendor to expedite 4 to EU today pending invoice — Jordan, you ok to approve up to $3k?

jordan-purchasing: Approve up to $3k for express and customs for this RMA. Please attach vendor invoice. I need GL code + approver for chargeback.

lee-logistics: Uploaded corrected commercial invoice (attached in thread). AWB: DHL 987654321. Expected delivery eus1: 2026-11-12 (EST).

rma-bot: Shipment DHL 987654321 scanned at LAX -> in transit to EU hub (2026-11-09T15:03:44Z)

alex-engr: Once ASN arrives I'll schedule node mapping. Reminder: if refurb units differ by >8% perf we'll apply canary throttles.

maria-ops: Jordan — please amend PO#5483 with freight line: 'DHL express split shipment — $1,100' and tag to infra-capex. Approvers: @maria-ops, @jordan-purchasing.

jordan-purchasing: Done. PO amended and sent to vendor. Vendor to confirm receipt.

nexa-supply-vendor: Received amended PO. ASN with serials attached. Shipping ETA to EU cluster confirmed. For the remaining 8 new units, we can expedite production to 4 weeks for additional $400/unit, alternative is standard 6–8 weeks.

sam-sre: Note cost tradeoff: expediting production reduces lead time but increases unit cost. Might be worth for critical clusters — let's decide after we confirm refurb performance.

maria-ops: Action items: 1) Vendor to confirm DHL delivery + serials (in ASN) — done. 2) Jordan to finalize PO amendment — done. 3) Alex to map serials to nodes on receipt. 4) Lee to monitor customs clear and update. 5) Decision on expediting remaining 8 due in 48h.

alex-engr: Will map on arrival and report perf delta.

lee-logistics: Customs cleared DHL 987654321 -> out for delivery EU hub (2026-11-11T09:20:00Z).

maria-ops: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in-thread if any new issues. :thumbsup:
